resources.string:
Take a screenshot on your phone, then tap Share and choose “Mockup Upload”. The screenshot goes into the Mockup editor’s inbox and appears in the editor within ~20 seconds.

Tip: copy the page URL from Chrome’s address bar before you screenshot — the app will pre-fill the Source URL from your clipboard.

Use “Test connection” below to confirm the server settings work.
Source URL (the website in the screenshot)
Ask your colleague to mint a device token for your work email (mint_device_token) and paste the mdt_… value here. It identifies your uploads.
Cloudflare Access service token — required to reach the server. Paste the Client Id / Secret from your Zero Trust service token.
Reads only the address bar in Chrome so screenshots you share get tagged with the page URL automatically. No other data is read or sent.
Auto-URL: On — Chrome page URLs are captured automatically.
Auto-URL: Off — tap to enable so the page URL fills in by itself.
